preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each non-empty line in stdin contains exactly one token (either an integer or a string).
The first line of stdin is an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 10) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(A) <= 1000 and 1 <= len(B) <= 1000 for A, B in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2]))
preconditions.description: For each test case, strings A and B are non-empty and have lengths between 1 and 1000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(A.islower() and B.islower() for A, B in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2]))
preconditions.description: Strings A and B consist only of lowercase alphabetic characters.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Yes' if any((s1 := A[i:j]) and (s2 := B[k:l]) and (s1 + s2) == (s1 + s2)[::-1] for A, B in zip(stdin.splitlines()[1::2], stdin.splitlines()[2::2]) for i in range(len(A)) for j in range(i + 1, len(A) + 1) for k in range(len(B)) for l in range(k + 1, len(B) + 1)) else 'No'
postconditions.description: For each test case, stdout contains 'Yes' if there exist non-empty substrings s1 of A and s2 of B such that the concatenation s1 + s2 is a palindrome; otherwise, it contains 'No'.
